# 'One Battle After Another' takes best picture. Here's the full list of Oscar winners
[![Beth Novey 2016](https://media.npr.org/assets/img/2016/06/14/bethnovey_sq-765891dd72994f8a0e0af0be5e4bb692582fe2fd.jpg?s=100&c=85&f=jpeg)](https://www.npr.org/people/348743704/beth-novey)

_One Battle After Another_ took home best picture at the 98th Oscars on Sunday night.

### [Prescient and political, 'One Battle After Another' is one of the year's best films](https://www.npr.org/2025/09/26/nx-s1-5552313/one-battle-after-another-review-leonardo-dicaprio)
**WINNER:** [**_One Battle After Another_**](https://www.npr.org/2025/09/26/nx-s1-5552313/one-battle-after-another-review-leonardo-dicaprio)

[_Marty Supreme_](https://www.npr.org/2025/12/25/nx-s1-5583930/marty-supreme-timothee-chalamet-marty-reisman-ping-pong-real-player)

[_Train Dreams_](https://www.npr.org/2025/11/15/nx-s1-5602865/director-and-co-writer-clint-bentley-talks-about-his-film-train-dreams)

### ['Hamnet' star Jessie Buckley looks for the 'shadowy bits' of her characters](https://www.npr.org/2026/03/02/nx-s1-5727541/jessie-buckley-hamnet-shakespeare)
**WINNER: Jessie Buckley, _Hamnet_**

### ['Sinners' gives Michael B. Jordan two roles of a lifetime](https://www.npr.org/2025/04/17/nx-s1-5366509/sinners-review-michael-b-jordan)
**WINNER: Michael B.**

**WINNER: Paul Thomas Anderson, _One Battle After Another_**

**WINNER: Amy Madigan, _Weapons_**

**WINNER: Sean Penn, _One Battle After Another_**

**WINNER: _KPop Demon Hunters_**

### [Stellan Skarsgård doesn't believe in bad guys](https://www.npr.org/2026/02/25/nx-s1-5726397/stellan-skarsgard-doesnt-believe-in-bad-guys)
**WINNER:** [**_Sentimental Value_**](https://www.npr.org/2025/11/11/nx-s1-5604824/sentimental-value-review-joachim-trier) **_,_ Norway**

[_The Voice of Hind Rajab,_](https://www.npr.org/2025/12/11/nx-s1-5518913/new-film-tells-the-story-of-the-desperate-attempt-to-rescue-a-girl-in-gaza) Tunisia

**WINNER: _Sinners_**

_Train Dreams_

**WINNER: _One Battle After Another_**

### [Here's how two very different films — 'Sirāt' and 'F1' — built worlds in sound](https://www.npr.org/2026/03/02/nx-s1-5725296/sirat-and-f1-put-a-spotlight-on-the-art-of-sound-design-in-movies)
**WINNER: _F1_**

### [At last, an Oscar for the people who decide who gets to star](https://www.npr.org/2026/03/05/nx-s1-5708949/nominees-talk-about-new-oscars-category-casting)

**WINNER: _Avatar: Fire and Ash_**

**WINNER: _Frankenstein_**

## 2024 – ‘Oppenheimer’
Robert Oppenheimer, which won Best Picture against _Barbie_ and more at the 2024 Oscars.

## 2023 – ‘Everything Everywhere All at Once’
From left, Michelle Yeoh and Jing Li in _Everything Everywhere All At Once_, which won the 2023 Best Picture award.

## 2022 – CODA
Apple’s _CODA_, starring [Best Supporting Actor winner Troy Kotsur](https://deadline.com/2022/02/coda-troy-kotsur-talks-historic-oscar-nom-its-meaning-to-deaf-community-1234928050/), nabbed the Best Picture trophy in 2022.

## 2021 – Nomadland
Frances McDormand starred in Chloe Zhao’s _Nomadland_, which won Best Picture in 2021.

## 2020 – Parasite
The thriller film won Best Picture at the 2020 Oscars.

## 5 Comments
### Submit a comment

# Academy Award for best picture
### Which movie won the 2026 Oscar for best picture?
_[One Battle After Another](https://www.britannica.com/topic/One-Battle-After-Another)_, directed by [Paul Thomas Anderson](https://www.britannica.com/biography/Paul-Thomas-Anderson), won best picture at the 2026 [Academy Awards](https://www.britannica.com/art/Academy-Award).

## 2000s and 2010s
- 2014: [_Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)_](https://www.britannica.com/topic/Birdman-film)
- 2016: [_Moonlight_](https://www.britannica.com/topic/Moonlight-2016-film)
- 2018: _Green Book_
- 2019: [_Parasite_](https://www.britannica.com/topic/Parasite-2019-film)

## 2020s
- 2023: [_Oppenheimer_](https://www.britannica.com/topic/Oppenheimer-film)
- 2024: _Anora_
- 2025: [_One Battle After Another_](https://www.britannica.com/topic/One-Battle-After-Another)
